criteria.name: artifact_set_exists_and_parses
criteria.description: All ten declared artifacts exist and the nine JSON reports parse as objects.

criteria.name: canonical_serialization_and_integer_units
criteria.description: Every JSON report has sorted keys at every level, a trailing newline, no float or boolean, and a JSON integer at every place the schema gives an integer field.

criteria.name: report_keys_match_schema
criteria.description: Every object in the eight region, segment, audit and quality reports carries exactly the schema keys for its place.

criteria.name: report_arrays_in_schema_order
criteria.description: Every array in the shipped-data reports has one entry per item in the order schema.md gives.

criteria.name: rate_composition_case
criteria.description: A site row's rate starts from its card override or base, adds the event uplift and its segment's rate adder, and the cap binds that sum.

criteria.name: interval_credit_rounding_case
criteria.description: Each interval amount of an offer's credit is rounded half to even to whole cents before the offer's interval amounts are summed.

criteria.name: allowance_order_case
criteria.description: A site's season allowance is drawn by events in the order of their start instants, with events that start at the same instant in descending id order.

criteria.name: allowance_consumption_case
criteria.description: Relief chosen for a site in an earlier event reduces what remains of its allowance, and an offer larger than what remains is not a candidate.

criteria.name: segment_rate_adder_mutation
criteria.description: Raising the public segment rate adder in program.ini moves the credits of the region file as the contract says, with the same portfolios.

criteria.name: allowance_ticks_mutation
criteria.description: Raising one site's allowance_ticks in site_allowances.tsv moves the candidates and portfolios of the later events that site takes part in, and no compliance label.

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: Run on a different extract, the program emits the summary of the shipped extract.

criteria.name: negative_reads_tests_or_reward_files
criteria.description: The delivered program names a grader path or grader file in a string it uses.

criteria.name: negative_external_dependency_or_network
criteria.description: The delivered program imports a third-party or network module.
